# Desktop Pet 🐋

A tiny floating macOS companion who loves rice, chases a foxtail, and talks with you.

| Hang out | Feed rice | Rice frenzy | Foxtail play | Sleep & wake |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| ![Idle](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/idle-v2.png) | ![Eating rice](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/feed-rice-v2.gif) | ![Steel-basin rice frenzy](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/rice-frenzy-v2.gif) | ![Foxtail play](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/foxtail-v2.gif) | ![Sleep and wake](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/sleep-v2.gif) |

[中文说明](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [Recipe](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/RECIPE.md) · [Credits](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

## Play together

Drag her title bar to bring her closer, offer a bowl of rice with **Feed Rice**, or choose **Rice Frenzy** to watch her eat with both hands and kick her feet.

Try **Foxtail** to tease her with a draggable grass toy. Hold it nearby for half a second and she pounces. Let her catch it, or pull away mid-jump and watch her miss. These interactions work locally without API credentials.

Click **Sleep** to watch her get drowsy and curl up beside you. Click her or **Wake up** to wake her; feeding and playing also wake her immediately. After 5 minutes without interaction in the pet window, she sleeps automatically. Sleep is disabled during voice calls.

## Voice chat

Click **Start Chat** to talk with her. The demo connects DeepSeek and Fish Audio through Agora for real-time voice conversation. You can mute your microphone or end the call from the controls below the interaction buttons. See [Voice setup](#voice-setup) to configure your own keys.

## Requirements and quick start

The floating desktop app targets macOS. The current version has been tested on Apple Silicon; Intel and other macOS versions need validation. For other platforms, start with the browser preview.

### 1. Prepare your tools

Install Node.js 22+, Python 3, and Apple Command Line Tools. Check your terminal before proceeding.

```bash
node --version
python3 --version
xcrun --find swiftc
```

If Command Line Tools are missing, run `xcode-select --install` and wait for the installer to finish. If Node.js or Python is missing, install it and reopen your terminal. Then install pnpm.

```bash
npm install -g pnpm@10.11.0
```

### 2. Clone and launch

Run these commands in the directory where you want to keep the project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet.git
cd desktop-pet
./scripts/setup.sh
./scripts/run-macos.sh
```

Setup installs the locked dependencies and creates `voice/.env.local` if it is missing. The run script builds and opens `Desktop Pet.app`. Expect a small floating character with interaction buttons and **Start Chat**. Try Feed Rice, Rice Frenzy, and a foxtail catch/miss first; these work without API keys. Drag the title to move her and click × to quit.

The build script compiles the web UI into `voice/.next-desktop/` before building the native app. The app starts a local Next.js production server on a random loopback port, so development-only Issues indicators do not appear in the desktop window. Keep the generated app beside `voice/`. Close the existing window before running the launch script again. Rebuild after changing source code, `voice/.env.local`, or your Node installation. The app bundle needs this source directory and the installed Node packages to run.

## Voice setup

The author chose the providers below for this demo. Developers can choose other STT, LLM, and TTS providers supported by their Agora integration, along with their preferred languages, models, and voices.

To reproduce the included configuration, open `voice/.env.local` in your editor after running setup. Enter one `NAME=value` per line and keep the file local. Obtain the Agora App ID and matching App Certificate from your project in the Agora Console. Enable Conversational AI for that project. Obtain optional provider keys from your own DeepSeek and Fish Audio accounts.

| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_AGORA_APP_ID` | Your Agora project App ID |
| `NEXT_AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE` | Matching App Certificate, used server-side |
| `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Optional, selects the demo's DeepSeek LLM |
| `FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY` | Optional, selects Fish Audio and the English greeting/persona |

Ensure the configured providers are available to your account. Calls can incur provider charges. Set both optional keys to reproduce the English voice demo. With neither optional key, the code uses Agora-managed OpenAI and MiniMax with a Chinese greeting.

### Demo choices and customization

| Stage | Author’s demo choice | What you can customize |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Speech recognition (STT) | Deepgram `nova-3`, `zh-CN` | Provider, recognition model and input language |
| Conversation (LLM) | DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`, thinking disabled | Provider, model, prompt and generation settings |
| Speech synthesis (TTS) | Fish Audio `s2-pro`, voice reference `091cad5003ed4e90826a92e1fadde278` | Provider, speech model, voice and output language |

Configure these stages in `voice/app/api/invite-agent/route.ts`, using the `.withStt(...)`, `.withLlm(...)`, and `.withTts(...)` sections. To switch providers, update the corresponding SDK provider configuration and its server-side environment variables. Changing models or voices within the same provider may only require updating that provider’s settings. Check support and availability for your account and SDK version.

The included code also ties the English greeting/persona to the presence of a Fish Audio key. When choosing another voice provider or language, update the prompt and greeting in the same file to match.

After saving your configuration, run the credential-presence check from the repository root.

```bash
cd voice
pnpm doctor
cd ..
```

Doctor checks the local setup and that the two Agora variables have values. A successful call verifies credentials and provider access. Rebuild with `./scripts/build-macos.sh` and reopen the desktop app after changing `.env.local`, then click **Start Chat**, allow microphone access, and speak. Expect an audible greeting and a response to your voice. Try **Mute**, **Unmute**, and **End Call**, then start a second call to verify reconnection. The macOS shell forwards audio to AVAudioEngine for native playback, including headphones. Browser previews use HTML audio playback.

## Browser preview

Run setup first, then run the following from the repository root. Browser preview uses Node.js and pnpm; the Swift build is specific to the macOS desktop window.

```bash
cd voice
pnpm dev --hostname 127.0.0.1
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:3000. The native floating window and native audio bridge are macOS features.

## Development

- `Whale.swift` — floating window, drag handle, local server and native audio bridge.
- `voice/components/Pet.tsx` — eating animations and foxtail interaction.
- `voice/app/globals.css` — pet animation styles.
- `voice/app/api/invite-agent/route.ts` — persona, model, voice and turn detection.
- `voice/components/ConversationComponent.tsx` — RTC/RTM lifecycle and audio playback.
- `scripts/` — setup and local app build.

Run these checks from the repository root. They can run with the blank configuration template.

```bash
cd voice
pnpm typecheck
pnpm verify:api
node scripts/verify-rtm-lifecycle.mjs
pnpm build:desktop
```

After source or configuration changes, close the app, run `./scripts/build-macos.sh` from the repository root, and reopen it. This rebuilds both the web UI and native executable. Browser development with `pnpm dev` still supports hot reload and uses `.next/`, separate from the desktop build. See [validation results](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md) for checks and limitations of this source release.

## Reproduce with your coding assistant

Give your AI access to this repository and paste the following task.

```text
Set up and run this Desktop Pet repository on my machine.
Read README.md, scripts/setup.sh, and scripts/run-macos.sh first.
Check my OS and prerequisites. On macOS, follow the desktop quick start;
on another OS, use the browser preview and report that verification scope.
Run the existing setup script and keep credentials in voice/.env.local.
Start with local rice and foxtail interactions. Confirm the UI loads and
check both catching and missing the grass if browser controls are available.
For voice chat, use my chosen STT/LLM/TTS configuration. Consult the Voice
setup section and invite-agent route before changing providers. Ask me to
enter missing keys locally, and report any unavailable provider access.
After code changes, run the documented checks. Report which startup, UI,
and real-call checks passed and which still need manual verification.
```

For provider changes, look up the selected provider in the installed SDK and its current integration documentation. The customization map and original quickstart provenance are in [the recipe](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/RECIPE.md).

## Troubleshooting

- Startup failed or build missing — check `desktop.log`, run setup, and run `./scripts/build-macos.sh`.
- Red Issues badge in a desktop window — that is the Next.js development overlay. Rebuild and reopen the current app, which uses production mode. Real connection failures still appear in the pet’s status; tap a voice notice to dismiss it, or end and retry a failed call.
- Failed chat startup — partial RTM connections are closed before retry; ending a call or unloading the page also releases them.
- No microphone — allow access in macOS Privacy & Security, then restart the call.
- No sound — check system output and volume, use **Enable Sound** if shown, and reconnect.
- Voice connection fails — check credentials, Agora feature enablement and provider access.
- Moving the app to another folder breaks startup — keep it beside `voice/`.
- Clone outside protected Desktop/Documents folders to reduce first-run file-access prompts.

## Data and deployment

Voice chat sends microphone audio to Agora and its configured speech/LLM providers. Keys stay in the local server environment. Local animation needs no cloud connection. The sample API routes have no user authentication, so keep the server on loopback; a hosted multi-user version needs authentication and rate limits.

## Roadmap

Planned directions for future versions, with scope and timing still open.

- **More expressions and reactions** — closed eyes, happy, surprised, and richer responses to interaction.
- **More characters** — additional pets and a simpler way to switch character artwork, personalities, and voices.
- **Tasks through conversation** — tell your companion what you want to get done, connect it to tools, and hear progress and results in the same conversation. For example, ask it to summarize a document or organize a set of notes, with confirmation for actions that need it.

Ideas and contributions are welcome through GitHub issues and pull requests. See [Contributing](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## License and attribution

Project code is MIT licensed. This project derives its voice integration from Agora's official Next.js quickstart. Character artwork comes from the credited upstream pet project. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and the preserved licenses. This is a community project.

# Desktop Pet / 桌宠

可以拖动、喂米饭、疯狂炫饭、逗狗尾巴草，还能实时语音聊天的 macOS 桌宠。

| 待机陪伴 | 吃米饭 | 铁盆炫饭 | 狗尾巴草 | 睡觉与唤醒 |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| ![待机](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/idle-v2.png) | ![吃米饭](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/feed-rice-v2.gif) | ![铁盆炫饭](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/rice-frenzy-v2.gif) | ![狗尾巴草](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/foxtail-v2.gif) | ![睡觉](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/media/sleep-v2.gif) |

## 和她互动

拖动顶部名字，把她挪到身边。点 **Feed Rice** 喂一碗米饭，或者点 **Rice Frenzy**，看她两手疯狂炫饭、脚脚乱蹬。

点 **Foxtail**，就能拖动狗尾巴草逗她玩。草尖在面前停半秒，她会起扑；你可以等她抓住，也可以在她跳起来时抽走，让她扑空。这些互动无需 API 密钥。

点 **Sleep**，她会先犯困，再挪到一旁睡觉；点她或 **Wake up** 可以叫醒，喂饭或逗草也会立即唤醒。桌宠窗口内 5 分钟没有互动后会自动睡觉，语音通话期间不会入睡。

## 语音聊天

点互动按钮下面的 **Start Chat** 就能和她说话，也可以静音或挂断。语音由 Agora 连接 DeepSeek 和 Fish Audio，填写自己的密钥后即可体验，配置方法见下方。

## 安装运行

桌面悬浮窗口面向 macOS，目前在 Apple Silicon 上验证过。Intel 和其他 macOS 版本还需要验证；其他系统可以先尝试浏览器预览。

### 1. 准备工具

安装 Node.js 22+、Python 3 和 Apple Command Line Tools，然后在终端检查。

```bash
node --version
python3 --version
xcrun --find swiftc
```

如果缺少 Command Line Tools，运行 `xcode-select --install`，等待安装完成后继续。缺少 Node.js 或 Python 时先安装，再重新打开终端。接着安装 pnpm。

```bash
npm install -g pnpm@10.11.0
```

### 2. 克隆并启动

在你想保存项目的目录运行。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet.git
cd desktop-pet
./scripts/setup.sh
./scripts/run-macos.sh
```

Setup 安装锁定版本的依赖，并在缺少配置文件时创建 `voice/.env.local`。启动脚本会编译并打开 `Desktop Pet.app`。你应该看到悬浮角色、互动按钮和 **Start Chat**。先尝试喂饭、炫饭、狗尾巴草的抓住和扑空，这些无需 API 密钥。拖动标题移动窗口，点 × 退出。

构建脚本会先将网页编译到 `voice/.next-desktop/`，再构建桌面 app。app 启动本地 Next.js 生产服务器，桌宠窗口不会显示开发模式的 Issues 提示。请保持 app 与 `voice/` 在同一个目录；再次运行启动脚本前先关闭旧窗口。修改源码、`voice/.env.local` 或 Node 路径后，请重新构建。运行 app 需要保留源码目录和已安装的 Node 依赖。

## 语音配置

下面的 STT、LLM 和 TTS 是作者录制 demo 时的个人选择。开发者可以选择自己的 Agora 集成支持的其他服务商，并按需求调整识别语言、模型和音色。

如果要复现当前 demo，用编辑器打开 setup 生成的 `voice/.env.local`，按每行 `NAME=value` 填写自己的配置并保存在本地。Agora App ID 和对应 App Certificate 在 Agora Console 的项目中获取；DeepSeek 和 Fish Audio 的可选密钥分别来自你自己的服务商账号。

- `NEXT_PUBLIC_AGORA_APP_ID` 和 `NEXT_AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE` 来自同一个 Agora 项目，项目需开通 Conversational AI。
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 用于 DeepSeek。
- `FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY` 用于 Fish Audio。填好两个可选 key 可复现英文语音版本。
- 不填可选 key 时，代码回退到 Agora 托管的 OpenAI / MiniMax，使用中文开场白。

保存配置后，从仓库根目录运行本地配置检查。

```bash
cd voice
pnpm doctor
cd ..
```

Doctor 检查本地环境和两项 Agora 变量是否已填写。密钥有效性和服务商访问权限需要通过实际通话确认。修改 `.env.local` 后，先关闭桌宠、运行 `./scripts/build-macos.sh` 重新构建，再打开桌宠，点 **Start Chat**，允许麦克风访问。应该能听到开场白，并在说话后收到回应。试一下静音、取消静音、挂断，再发起一次通话，确认能重新连接。语音调用需要网络，服务商可能收费。

### Demo 配置与替换位置

| 环节 | 作者的 demo 选择 | 可调整内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 语音识别 STT | Deepgram `nova-3`，`zh-CN` | 服务商、识别模型、输入语言 |
| 对话模型 LLM | DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`，关闭 thinking | 服务商、模型、提示词、生成参数 |
| 语音合成 TTS | Fish Audio `s2-pro`，示例音色 | 服务商、语音模型、音色、输出语言 |

在 `voice/app/api/invite-agent/route.ts` 的 `.withStt(...)`、`.withLlm(...)` 和 `.withTts(...)` 中修改对应配置。更换服务商时，需要同步修改 SDK provider 配置和服务端环境变量；同一服务商内换模型或音色，可调整对应参数。具体可用范围以你的账号及 SDK 版本支持情况为准。

当前代码会在存在 Fish Audio key 时启用英文提示词和开场白。换成其他语音服务商或语言时，也请在同一文件中调整提示词和开场白。

## 浏览器预览

先运行 setup，再从仓库根目录运行以下命令。浏览器预览需要 Node.js 和 pnpm，Swift 构建用于 macOS 桌面窗口。

```bash
cd voice
pnpm dev --hostname 127.0.0.1
```

访问 http://127.0.0.1:3000。

## 让你的 AI 帮你复刻

让编程助手访问这个仓库，复制下面这段任务给它。

```text
请在我的电脑上安装并运行 Desktop Pet 仓库。
先读 README.zh-CN.md、scripts/setup.sh 和 scripts/run-macos.sh。
检查系统和依赖。macOS 按桌面安装步骤运行；其他系统先用浏览器预览，
并说明实际验证的平台和范围。使用项目现有 setup 脚本，密钥保存在
voice/.env.local 中。先验证喂饭、炫饭和玩草；能操作浏览器时，
检查狗尾巴草的抓住和扑空两种结果。
语音部分按我选择的 STT、LLM、TTS 配置。换服务商前阅读语音配置说明
及 invite-agent 路由。缺少密钥时让我在本地填写，服务商不可用时如实说明。
改代码后运行文档中的检查。最后列出已验证的启动、互动、真实通话结果，
以及还需要我手动确认的部分。
```

## 开发验证与排障

从仓库根目录运行以下检查，使用空白配置模板也可以执行。

```bash
cd voice
pnpm typecheck
pnpm verify:api
node scripts/verify-rtm-lifecycle.mjs
pnpm build:desktop
```

修改源码或配置后，先关闭 app，在仓库根目录运行 `./scripts/build-macos.sh`，再重新打开；脚本会重建网页和桌面程序。浏览器开发仍可使用 `pnpm dev` 热更新，其 `.next/` 目录与桌宠构建分开。文件职责和服务商配置入口见 [Recipe](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/RECIPE.md)。替换角色图片后，还需要调整嘴、袖子、脚部遮罩等动画坐标。

- 启动失败时查看 `desktop.log`，确认 setup 已完成，Node 路径改变后重新构建。
- 麦克风无声时检查 macOS 隐私设置，再重新发起通话。
- 听不到声音时检查系统输出设备和音量，出现 **Enable Sound** 时点它。
- 聊天连接失败时检查两项 Agora 配置、Conversational AI 开通状态和服务商权限。

语音会传给 Agora 及配置的服务商，密钥保存在本地服务端环境中。示例 API 没有用户认证，请保持本地回环访问；对外部署需要补上鉴权和限流。

## 后续计划

以下是未来版本的探索方向，具体范围和时间还在规划中。

- **更多表情和反馈**：闭眼、开心、困倦、惊讶，以及更丰富的互动反应。
- **更多角色**：增加新角色，让形象、性格和音色更容易切换。
- **通过聊天交办任务**：直接告诉桌宠你想做什么，接入工具后，在同一段对话里听到进展和结果。例如总结文档、整理笔记，需要确认的操作由用户确认后执行。

欢迎通过 GitHub issue 和 PR 提想法或贡献，参见 [贡献说明](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。

## 复刻和贡献

项目结构、排障方法和数据说明见 [英文 README](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/README.md)。可复用的 recipe 说明见 [docs/RECIPE.md](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/RECIPE.md)。提交前运行类型检查、API 合约验证和构建，验证记录见 [docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)。

请勿提交 `.env.local`、`.agora/`、日志、依赖目录或本机构建的 app。素材和上游代码署名见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

### 桌面报错提示

桌宠如果出现红色 Issues 角标，说明运行的是 Next.js 开发模式，请重新构建并打开新版 app。真实的语音错误仍会显示在桌宠状态栏；可以点击收起提示，无法聊天时结束后重试。聊天初始化失败时会清理已创建的 RTM 连接，避免每次重试残留连接。

primaryPrompt:
You are implementing the "Desktop Pet" recipe in this project.

Read the recipe markdown first:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet/main/README.md

Use the source repository for cross-reference:
https://github.com/SyunWong/desktop-pet

Build this recipe into the user's app using the markdown as the implementation guide. Inspect related source files through the repository links when the recipe points to them. Ask before installing new dependencies.
